title_zh: 三处自动驾驶节点功能带计划
author: 许丙南 / Codex
boundary_note: These are relational interface plans, not road sections, parcels, red lines, construction drawings, traffic approvals, or field results.

nodes.ordinary_route: station or park arrival → accessible crossing → public status board → ordinary park return
nodes.service_relation: Evaluation remains behind a closable managed interface; it cannot cut the ordinary accessible chain.
stop_rules: river, flood-control, traffic, ownership, fire, or energy evidence is missing
a robot blocks the accessible chain
remote stop or on-site handover cannot be verified

nodes.name_zh: AI 原点无障碍服务庭
nodes.ordinary_route: residential or campus edge → paper or telephone service desk → assisted route → quiet residential edge
functional_bands: human service desk and non-app entry
assisted booking or low-speed service window
nodes.service_relation: Automation is optional; paper, telephone, and face-to-face service remain first-class entrances.
stop_rules: the same service cannot be completed through an ordinary human route
consent, accessibility, or data-minimisation evidence is incomplete
resident complaint or withdrawal cannot be received offline

nodes.ordinary_route: rail arrival → four-way pedestrian crossing → quiet seat → daily retail or public-service return
nodes.service_relation: Transfer, loading, and public explanation are separated as reversible windows; no window may occupy fire, accessible, or emergency routes.
stop_rules: station, road, fire, crowd, retail, or emergency evidence is missing
event, rain, snow, or network loss removes the human-only route
the space cannot return to ordinary daily use after the window closes

professional_boundary: Dimensions, capacity, speed, road right-of-way, building control, permit, operator, and performance values remain unknown until official data, field evidence, and professional review are available.
